subject: 英语
source: 人教版PEP小学英语（三年级起点）教材单元话题整理
original_text:
【核心词汇】bread 面包; juice 果汁; egg 蛋; milk 牛奶; water 水; cake 蛋糕; fish 鱼; rice 米饭
【重点句型】I'd like some ..., please. 我想要一些…… Here you are. 给你。 Have some ... 吃一些…… Can I have some ..., please? 我能要一些……吗？ You're welcome. 不客气。
【A Let's talk】Sarah: I'd like some juice, please. Mum: Here you are. Sarah: Thank you. Mum: You're welcome. Sarah: Can I have some bread, please? Mum: Here you are.
【Read and write】I'd like some bread and eggs. I'd like some juice and milk. Have some cake. Have some rice. Eat some fish. Drink some water. Cut the cake. Eat the bread.
key_points: I'd like some ..., please. 我想要一些……
Can I have some ..., please? 我能要一些……吗？
